user_saw: After switching conversations, users could still see a grouped conversation created by an agent in the sidebar, but searching for its title or transcript text returned no results.
summary: The fix makes ordinary agent-spawned conversations in custom groups eligible for search and shared navigation while retaining the subagent, visibility, and archive filters.
reasoning: The shared UI filter already used `!row.spawnedBy` to keep child rows out of the top-level session inventory, and #126388 exposed the gap by promoting categorized children into sidebar groups while leaving that filter in place. I checked that the palette already used the exclusion for title and transcript search before #152314 moved those filters to the Gateway, where the same exclusion continued.
